lessons_published: Adjacent pages repeated one payout at their boundary. The final page carried a continuation token. The API answered one request with HTTP 429 and a retry delay, and the identical request then succeeded. A controlled amended-record fixture shows that keeping the first value loses final truth; the last value by ID preserves it.
